Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 69-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their fourth dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-02-17.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Kim (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter442@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
